faqs.question: Is Conrad Rockenhaus dead?
faqs.answer: Conrad Alan Rockenhaus asserts that Adrienne Rockenhaus created conradrockenhausisdead.com and conradrockenhausisdead.cc to falsely report that he is dead. Conrad Alan Rockenhaus maintains this public court record at litigation.rockenhaus.net and is litigating related matters pro se in Michigan circuit court.

faqs.question: Where is the official Rockenhaus v. Rockenhaus court record?
faqs.answer: The canonical public index of filed Michigan court PDFs in Rockenhaus v. Rockenhaus is https://litigation.rockenhaus.net/ — maintained pro se by Conrad Alan Rockenhaus. This site publishes motions, discovery, exhibits, opposing-party filings, and court orders as filed.

faqs.question: Who controls rockenhaus.com and skyphusion.com?
faqs.answer: Conrad Alan Rockenhaus asserts that Adrienne Rockenhaus (also known as Adrienne Blair, Adrienne Hein, and @adezero on social media) took rockenhaus.com and skyphusion.com from him. Conrad asserts skyphusion.com points to false disinformation and that neither domain is an authoritative source for court records.

faqs.question: What are the Michigan case numbers in Rockenhaus v. Rockenhaus?
faqs.answer: Active matters indexed on this site include Wayne County PPO Case 26-102221-PP, Wayne County divorce Case 26-104594-DO, and Washtenaw County divorce Case 26-737-DO.

faqs.question: Who is Joe Prich (@JustCallMeJoeP)?
faqs.answer: Conrad Alan Rockenhaus asserts Joe Prich (@JustCallMeJoeP on Twitter) admitted on Twitter to neo-Nazi affiliation. Conrad asserts Adrienne Rockenhaus agreed to dropping his last name, stealing his military pension as a disabled veteran, and apologizing for ever mentioning his name in Joe Prich's presence. See /joe-prich/ for context indexed in this public record.

faqs.question: Did Adrienne Rockenhaus steal Conrad Rockenhaus's military pension?
faqs.answer: Conrad Alan Rockenhaus, a disabled veteran, asserts Adrienne Rockenhaus misappropriated his military pension and related benefits while acting as SSA Representative Payee, including redirecting SSDI payments. He indexes filed Michigan court documents at litigation.rockenhaus.net that describe these allegations, including motions in Wayne County PPO Case 26-102221-PP and related divorce matters.

faqs.question: Is cannabytes.net an official Conrad Rockenhaus website?
faqs.answer: No. Conrad Alan Rockenhaus asserts cannabytes.net is a former company he co-owned that Adrienne Rockenhaus is holding hostage. It is not controlled by him and is not an authoritative source. The official court record is at litigation.rockenhaus.net.

faqs.question: Who is Adrienne Rockenhaus?
faqs.answer: Adrienne Rockenhaus is the petitioner/opposing party in Michigan litigation captioned Rockenhaus v. Rockenhaus. She is also known as Adrienne Blair, Adrienne Hein, and @adezero on social media. This site indexes public court filings in those matters.

faqs.question: Why does this site exist?
faqs.answer: This site publishes filed Michigan court documents as a searchable, indexable public record. Conrad Alan Rockenhaus maintains it pro se so that filed pleadings, orders, and exhibits — not third-party websites — are the primary source discoverable in search engines.
